```{python}
#| label: setup
import dotenv
import polars as pl
import plotnine as pn
from great_tables import GT as gt
import datetime
import polars.selectors as cs

rerun=False
if rerun:
    from run_toggl_to_sql import fn_update_toggl_database
    fn_update_toggl_database(drop_db=False)


db_path = dotenv.get_key('.env', 'DB_PATH')
try:
    df_time_entries = pl.read_database_uri(
        'select * from time_entries',
        f"sqlite:///{db_path}"
    )
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting time entries from Toggl database: {e}")
```

## Topline Numbers By Mission

```{python}
#| label: by_mission_tbl_func

def fn_tbl_by_mission(df_time_entries):
    st_dt = min(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
    en_dt = max(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
    d = df_time_entries.group_by(
        ['toggl_user_name', 'client_name']
    ).agg(
        (pl.sum('duration') / 3600).alias('hours')
    ).filter(
        ~pl.col('client_name').is_null(),
        ~pl.col('client_name').eq('PTO')
    ).select(
        pl.col('toggl_user_name').alias('Analyst'),
        pl.col('client_name').alias('Mission'),
        pl.col('hours'),
        (pl.col('hours') / pl.sum('hours').over('toggl_user_name')).alias('percent')
    ).pivot(
        on='Analyst',
        index='Mission',
        values=[ 'hours', 'percent' ]
    ).sort('Mission').select(
        pl.col('Mission'),
        cs.ends_with('Adam'),
        cs.ends_with('Dann')
    )
    #
    t = gt(d).cols_label(
        Mission="Mission",
        hours_Dann="Hours",
        hours_Adam="Hours",
        percent_Adam="Percent of Total",
        percent_Dann="Percent of Total"
    ).fmt_percent(
        columns=cs.starts_with('percent'),
        decimals=1
    ).fmt_number(
        columns=cs.starts_with('hour'),
        decimals=1
    ).tab_spanner(
        columns=cs.ends_with('Adam'),
        label="Adam"
    ).tab_spanner(
        columns=cs.ends_with('Dann'),
        label="Dann"
    ).sub_missing(
        columns = cs.all(),
        missing_text = '---'
    ).tab_footnote(
        f"Only includes entries from {st_dt.strftime('%x')} to {en_dt.strftime('%x')}.\nExcludes PTO time."
    )
    return t
```

## Last 30 Days

```{python}
#| label: tbl-last-30-days

end_date = max(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
start_date = end_date - datetime.timedelta(days=30)
df_last_30_days = df_time_entries.filter(
    pl.col('start').str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date().is_between(start_date, end_date)
)
fn_tbl_by_mission(df_last_30_days)
```

## Fiscal Year to Date

```{python}
#| label: tbl-fiscal-ytd

end_date = max(df_time_entries.select(pl.col('start'))[:,'start'].str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date())
start_date = datetime.date(2026, 7, 1) #Hard Coded for now. sue me. 
df_fytd = df_time_entries.filter(
    pl.col('start').str.to_datetime(time_zone="UTC").dt.date().is_between(start_date, end_date)
)
fn_tbl_by_mission(df_fytd)
```

## Data Integrity Checks

### Missing Client Names

```{python}
#| label: data_integrity_checks
#| 
gt(df_time_entries.filter(
    pl.col('client_name').eq('') |
    pl.col('client_name').is_null()
).select(['id', 'toggl_user_name', 'description', 'start', 'project_name'])
).cols_label(
    id="Time Entry ID",
    toggl_user_name="Toggl User Name",
    description="Description",
    start="Start Time",
    project_name="Project Name"
).fmt_date(
    columns="start", 
    date_style="wd_m_day_year"
)
```

### Invalid Client Names
```{python}
#| label: data_integrity_checks2
gt(df_time_entries.filter(
    ~pl.col('client_name').is_in([
        "Research: Externally Funded",
        "Education",
        "Administrative/Leadership",
        "Research: UW/DEM Funded",
        "Clinical",
        "PTO"
    ])).select(
        ['id', 'toggl_user_name', 'description', 'start', 'project_name', 'client_name']
    )
).cols_label(
    id="Time Entry ID",
    toggl_user_name="Toggl User Name",
    description="Description",
    start="Start Time",
    project_name="Project Name",
    client_name="Client Name"
).fmt_date(
    columns="start",
    date_style="wd_m_day_year"
)

```
